sources.title: ChemicalOCR API & Inference Endpoint | FriendliAI
sources.snippet: ChemicalOCR is a key component of MarkushGrapher-2, an end-to-end model for multimodal recognition of chemical structures from patent documents. In the MarkushGrapher-2 pipeline, ChemicalOCR provides the text and layout information that is fused with visual features for Markush structure recognition.

sources.title: OCSR.ai - Chemical Intelligence Engine | Search 1.3T Molecules
sources.snippet: Search 1.3 trillion molecules with AI-powered Chemical Intelligence Engine. Find chemical structures by IUPAC name, SMILES, InChI, draw structures, or upload images. 93.2% handwritten accuracy, 40M+ reactions. Free chemical search engine for researchers.
